title: Constitutional Capitalism — Reviewer's Charter
rule: Provide this charter when inviting first collaborators. Does not activate Collaborative Constitutional Review platform. Does not recruit advocates.

primary_objective.text: The goal is not to convince the reviewer that Constitutional Capitalism is correct. The goal is to convince the reviewer that Constitutional Capitalism is intellectually serious.
primary_objective.successful_first_review_sounds_like: I don't agree with everything here, but this is a serious piece of scholarship that deserves to be engaged on its merits.
primary_objective.not_success: early consensus or agreement with every conclusion

signals_of_intellectual_seriousness: I can see how the conclusions were reached

falsifiability_signal.text: Every proof packet is required to be capable of disproving the doctrine it examines.
falsifiability_signal.why_it_matters: Signals attempt to avoid confirmation bias; does not guarantee success, but signals intellectual honesty

expected_challenge_questions: How sensitive are the results to different assumptions?
What happens if participation is lower than expected?
What incentives might produce unintended behavior?
Under what conditions would this policy fail?
reviewer_is_asked: Does the reasoning follow from the evidence?
What additional literature should be considered?
reviewer_is_not_asked: To become an advocate or co-author of doctrine

multi_hat_reviewer_value.note: A first external reviewer who combines economics PhD, government advisory, political leadership, and practical-governance candidacy is valuable for the kinds of scrutiny they provide—not for expected agreement.

prepared_by_prior_decisions: Hypotheses distinguished from stable identity / doctrine graduation gates
when_to_use: After material proof-packet progress (especially PP-FF-01 methodology demonstration), when inviting first scholarly collaborators — still before Phase 8 public platform activation unless gates are met.

culture.note: Serious scholars appreciate being invited to improve a framework rather than endorse it.

registration_model.rule: Register by disciplinary perspective and optionally by analytical framework — not by political identity labels (e.g., libertarian, conservative, progressive as registration categories).
forbids: partisan labels as required profile fields

analytical_perspectives_optional.title: Analytical Perspectives (optional)
analytical_perspectives_optional.purpose: Allow AI and future readers to understand the lens of a review without reducing reviewers to partisan labels.

multi_perspective_review.title: Multi-perspective review
multi_perspective_review.rule: Far more valuable than 100 general comments: the same doctrine reviewed by distinct professional perspectives.

coverage_dashboard_deferred.title: Reviewer coverage dashboards (much later)
coverage_dashboard_deferred.note: Ensure major disciplines have meaningfully engaged relevant parts of the framework — not unanimous agreement.
